name: breach-command
description: Single-player incident response card game with an adaptive computer Incident Captain.

paragraphs: Breach Command is a public, single-player incident-response card game played against a rule-based computer Incident Captain. Its scenarios, wording, characters, systems and presentation are original and fictional.
Play the current release at breach-command.vercel.app. Release 0.9.54: see the release notes.

The title artwork fills the viewport on desktop, iPad and phone, cropping its edges as needed. Tall phones use a dedicated composition with extra sky and terrace space to keep the embedded logo fully visible. The entry button and release/build label remain within the screen's safe area as browser controls resize the view.

whatItDoes.text: Breach Command is a public, single-player incident-response card game played against a rule-based computer Incident Captain. Its scenarios, wording, characters, systems and presentation are original and fictional.

requirements.text: Graduated sector decisions: every sector crisis offers a decisive measure, a narrow one and a permissive one — reset only the exposed accounts, move only the affected clinical lane, require out-of-band approval above a lowered threshold — because a real incident is rarely a choice between stopping and carrying on.
Portable backup text can transfer progress without an account; imports validate nested records and have size, nesting and message-shape limits.
